verdict.rationale: CockroachDB exposes a well-documented, driver-agnostic PostgreSQL wire protocol (verified live via `cockroach demo` running real SQL) plus a documented MCP server for natural-language driving of read/write operations, both confirmed live in the probes. However, there is no discoverable OpenAPI/REST spec (all candidate paths 404), so a fully machine-readable HTTP API for cloud/cluster management is absent — missing for 10: a public OpenAPI/REST spec for cluster administration, independent hands-on confirmation of the MCP server's read/write actions beyond the documented claim.
